item.title: ADGM reinforces Abu Dhabi’s position as global financial hub
item.description: ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, delivered strong growth in the first half of 2026, with assets under management (AUM) rising 54 per cent year on year and its workforce reaching 49,027 professionals.
